caption: One continuous home-kitchen cooking event. The invariant subject is the same single intact sunny-side-up egg in the same dark non-stick frying pan on the same stovetop, with one glossy golden yolk, set white, crisp bubbling edges, small green herb flecks, warm oil sheen, and warm kitchen lighting. The egg remains whole and recognizable across every cut.
invariant_caption: The same single intact sunny-side-up egg remains whole in the same dark non-stick pan, with one glossy yolk, set white, herb flecks, and shimmering oil.
contrast_caption: The egg has been scrambled, broken into pieces, turned into an omelet, or stir-fried in a wok.
